P7.1: give the outbox dispatcher its own database role (D-061, D-076)

Migration 0010 revokes claim_due_outbox and finish_outbox from the request
role and grants them to opsbridge_dispatcher, which reads only the rules of
the workspace it sets. New HYPERDRIVE_DISPATCH binding; release-config gate
requires three separate Hyperdrive configs.
